scenarios.description: Go structs and fields retain deterministic package containers and prefix filtering.
provenance_assertions: container/nested declarations: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision
nested symbol reachable through namespace_prefix filtering

scenarios.description: Go import aliases are recorded as syntax import facts.
provenance_assertions: import/alias facts: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision

scenarios.description: Production and _test.go files use module-aware source roles.
provenance_assertions: file inventory: git provenance; roles from ecosystem path conventions

scenarios.description: Duplicate function names across packages yield candidates and typed ambiguity.
provenance_assertions: duplicate names: every candidate listed; ambiguity is a typed error, never guessed

scenarios.description: Static Go function calls provide bounded callers without a precise provider.
provenance_assertions: call edges: tree_sitter provenance, heuristic precision, no precise provider

scenarios.description: Go Test* functions in _test.go files are identified as tests.
provenance_assertions: test hint: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision, test source role
text hits: text_search provenance, textual precision
limit exceedance: truncated flag plus section/cause detail

scenarios.description: Malformed Go publishes diagnostics while valid declarations remain.
provenance_assertions: broken file: actionable diagnostics with file attribution; intact declarations stay queryable
repair: diagnostics cleared on a newer published revision

scenarios.description: Create, modify, atomic save, rename, and delete are fresh.
provenance_assertions: create/modify/atomic-save/rename/delete: each step visible to the next fresh query

scenarios.description: diff_context attributes Go worktree and base-ref changes.
provenance_assertions: changed-file facts: git provenance; worktree and base-ref scopes attribute disjoint file sets

scenarios.description: Go callers remain available through the Chakra-owned syntax equivalent.
provenance_assertions: provider absent: queries answer with syntax provenance, state not_configured, no failure

scenarios.description: Provider failure degrades to syntax and recovery restores precise references.
provenance_assertions: provider crash: explicit fallback, syntax facts retained, precision never upgraded silently
provider recovery: precise facts merge with precise precision and provider provenance

scenarios.description: A Go function with 56 callers is complete at explicit limits and bounded by default.
provenance_assertions: 56 call sites: complete heuristic callers at an explicit limit; default limit truncates explicitly
